top_signals.title: United CEO Kirby Defends Support of a US Wealth Tax
top_signals.summary: United Airlines CEO Scott Kirby addressed his thoughts on a wealth tax in the United States, saying his view of a fair system would be some way of taxing wealth growth coupled with lower income taxes. He spoke on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Timing to roll out US Army’s NGC2 depends on funds, commander says
top_signals.summary: The head of the Army formation responsible for fielding the Next Generation Command and Control system said the timeline depends on resources available.

top_signals.title: Solana’s Alpenglow launches on mainnet, targets 99% faster finality
top_signals.summary: Solana’s first major consensus upgrade is targeting 99% finality reduction, seeking to offer users near-immediate transaction settlement and more responsive applications.
